title: Quiet money (batch 12): quiet stablecoin & crypto-infrastructure fortunes (Tether/Cantor, Wintermute, Bitmain)
source: Public record: Tether/Bitfinex + Cantor Fitzgerald reporting; Howard Lutnick confirmation + divestiture coverage; Wintermute; Bitmain/Bitdeer filings. Catalog layer (#242 batch 12). Structural overlay; person nodes carry dossiers. FOCUS: the deliberately opaque fortunes behind stablecoin + crypto plumbing - Tether (now a top-20-scale US Treasury holder) and its Cantor custody, quiet crypto market-makers, and the mining-ASIC money pivoting into AI datacenters. HONESTY: ownership/custody/roles = fact; conflict-of-interest + systemic framings graded; no cabal imputed.

edges.notes: Cantor Fitzgerald custodies/manages the bulk of Tether's ~$120B+ US-Treasury reserves and took a stake in Tether (~5%, ~$600M) - so the world's largest, deliberately-opaque stablecoin parks its reserves at a single primary dealer (fact; exact figures partly disclosed).

Cantor is a US primary dealer; via Tether's reserves + its own SPAC/crypto ventures it is a major conduit routing stablecoin cash into Treasuries - a quiet node linking crypto liquidity to Treasury demand (fact of role; magnitude graded).
Howard Lutnick built + long ran Cantor Fitzgerald (and BGC/Newmark); he handed control to his sons on becoming US Commerce Secretary in 2025 (fact).

Lutnick became US Commerce Secretary (2025); his prior Cantor role - custodian of Tether's reserves + a crypto dealmaker - drew conflict-of-interest scrutiny despite a pledged divestiture (fact of role + divestiture pledge; conflict framing graded/interpretation).
Evgeny Gaevoy founded Wintermute - a top algorithmic crypto market-maker + OTC liquidity provider; a low-profile crypto-trading fortune (fact).
Jihan Wu co-founded Bitmain - the dominant Bitcoin-mining ASIC maker (Antminer) - a quiet, geopolitically-sensitive hardware fortune (fact).
Wu leads Bitdeer (spun out of Bitmain; Nasdaq-listed) - a mining + datacenter operator now pivoting hash-rate infrastructure toward AI compute (fact).
Bitmain's ASIC dominance makes it a chokepoint on Bitcoin mining hardware (hash-rate supply) - quiet hardware control under the whole PoW network (fact of market position).

Bitdeer (like other miners: Core Scientific, TeraWulf, IREN) is converting power-rich mining sites into AI datacenters - the crypto-mining-to-AI-compute pivot that ties quiet mining money to the AI-power buildout (fact).

Wintermute (with Cumberland/Jane Street/Jump) provides the market-making liquidity that keeps stablecoins + tokens trading at scale - a concentrated, quiet layer under crypto markets (fact of category).
